notes.title: Merry Christmas 2.0!! 🎄👻
notes.content:
[b]Update 2.0 – Visual improvements and essential adjustments[/b]

Excited to reveal our latest game update! Focused on elevating the player experience, making every moment engaging and captivating. Here's what to expect:

[b]1. Improved graphics:[/b]
Significant time and effort invested in refining the game's graphics for a stunning, detailed visual aesthetic. Textures, shadows and effects have been adjusted, providing a more immersive and visually pleasing gaming experience.

[b]2. Increased protagonist's resistance:[/b]
Recognizing the importance of the protagonist's stamina, we have adjusted the stamina levels at different difficulty levels. Players can now prepare for more intense challenges as their characters' resilience adapts more evenly to the demands of the game.

[b]3. Functional Steam Achievements:[/b]
I'm thrilled to announce fully operational Steam achievements! Challenge yourself to reach new heights and unlock exclusive achievements on this epic journey. Show your skills and dedication by achieving goals, ranging from remarkable feats to daring challenges. Now, more than ever, your achievements can be recognized and celebrated, enriching the overall gaming experience. Get ready to elevate your gameplay by overcoming challenges and leaving your mark among great adventurers!

[b]4. Bug fixes:[/b]
By carefully listening to player feedback, we have dedicated significant resources to eliminating numerous bugs that could disrupt the gameplay experience. From minor rendering issues to more complex challenges, our team has worked diligently to ensure smoother, hit-free gameplay.

notes.title: New update 1.3!
notes.content:
New update 1.3!

Now the game contains New Difficulty Levels.

Difficulty levels were implemented within the game, the levels are: Easy, Normal and Hard

Players can choose which difficulty level is best for their game!

Let's see who can beat the game on hard mode!

notes.title: Bug Fix Update 1.2
notes.content:
Bug Fix Update 1.2

1 - Bugs in enemy AI have been fixed
Example: Enemy was stuck in the door and the player was unable to progress.
This bug has been fixed and improved, so enemies no longer get stuck in game locations.

2 - Enemy AI has been improved, it is more intelligent when chasing and looking for the player

3 - Bugs and glitches have all been fixed

4 - The player's stamina has been increased and the enemy's speed has also been increased
